title: Aviation Contracting Industry Day
detail_text: The US Forest Service will be hosting an Industry Day event in Boise on May 12, 2026 (9AM to 4PM) to discuss Aviation Contracting issues in the wildland fire support realm. We plan to have participation from our partner Agencies (DOI) and have a variety of US Forest Service personnel from the program and contracting side. Please RSVP to event using the attached Micorsoft Forms Link: https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=5zZb7e4BvE6GfuA8-g1GlzyS8QqGhEZPngEBBtCE_6lUQTZISk9HRUoyUzY5RDRXTE1NNk5RVzhaWC4u We plan on posting a draft agenda the week of May 4. The event will be hosted at: Jack's Urban Meeting Place 1000 W Myrtle St Boise, ID 83702
